mentions.name: Painted Stone Tracking Map
mentions.description: A website for tracking painted stones on a map, similar to geocaching but showing each stone's travel path and the comments left by people who find it. Stones are tagged with QR codes that finders glue to the back.
mentions.source_excerpt:
i am working on a website to track painted stones on a map. similar to geocaching but you can see their path and the comments people leave when they find one.
powered using QR codes people have to glue on the back.
